capability_exceptions.bounded_evidence: All six rated sources are easy. The two unrated two-fragment blanks have missing correct references and solutions. Every source uses exactly orientation reversal and coordinate selection. Archived moderate/hard representations only change denominator size or decimal notation (and denominator clearing in experimental blanks), without a source-backed moderate/hard workload. Those research samples are not admitted as supported bands. This is a package capability boundary, not a global impossibility claim.
capability_exceptions.reopen: New rated or validated same-KP instructional evidence
